meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先分析你的 git 仓库:检查当前改动、最近提交和分支状态,然后按仓库风格把改动拆成多个原子提交,也能执行 rebase/squash 或追溯某行代码/某次改动的来历。
howto.when: 当你说出 “commit”、“rebase”、“squash” 等词,或询问某改动是谁写的、何时加入时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动按模块拆成几个提交
say.note: 它会先生成提交计划,再逐批提交。

say.text: 把最近这三个提交压缩成一个
查一下这行代码是哪次提交加的
say.note: 它会用 git blame/log 查找出处。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes the git repo, checks changes and branch state, splits work into atomic commits in the repo's style, and can rebase/squash or trace the origin of a line.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or ask who wrote something / when it was added.

say_en.text: Split these changes into atomic commits by module.
say_en.note: It will create a plan and commit in batches.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: It uses rebase --autosquash to merge them.

say_en.text: Find which commit added this line.
say_en.note: It uses git blame/log to locate it.
